purpose: Find permitted, reproducible building-level address and geometry evidence for exact Astana address matches.

decision.source: OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik Kazakhstan pinned PBF
decision.reason: A public regional snapshot supports one bulk download and fully offline address matching; it avoids repeated per-address geocoding requests.
decision.claim: A unique complete address matches a valid building footprint in the cached OSM snapshot.
not_established: Official cadastral identity, land registry ownership, or field-survey confirmation.
Exact apartment location within a building or a transaction date.
Completeness of OSM addresses in Astana.
Independent fresh model validation or an improvement in model accuracy.

findings: OSM permits copying, transmission, distribution, and adaptation subject to its licence.
Credit OpenStreetMap contributors and link the licence when distributing OSM-derived data.
Keep the derived address-to-coordinate crosswalk and source provenance separately identifiable with ODbL attribution; do not label the derived data CC0.
Data licensing and the usage policy of an individual hosting service are separate.

sources.date_evidence: Kazakhstan download page and independently read PBF header agree: osmosis_replication_timestamp=2026-10-12T20:21:35Z, sequence4919, generator=osmium/1.16.0.
findings: The country page defines no smaller subregions; no dedicated Astana extract was advertised there.
PBF preserves the original OSM tags and topology for offline filtering; derived GIS formats need not preserve every multilingual/address tag.
The public extract excludes contributor user names, user IDs, and changeset IDs according to Geofabrik's notice.
Snapshot freshness is database currency, not the survey date or correctness of each building.
sources.network_scope: One HEAD and one streaming GET of the pinned PBF. No archive retries or latest fallback were needed.

sources.usage_summary: The operator prioritizes light users; its broad guidance is about 10000 requests and under 1 GB daily. Do not use the public service as a live application backend or issue large numbers of per-element requests. A single cached city query is modest usage, not a guarantee of availability.

probe.result: No usable boundary or building data received.
probe.follow_up: No Overpass retries, alternate endpoint requests, or bulk Overpass query after this response. Switched to the explicitly public Geofabrik regional download.

findings: The public server discourages bulk geocoding and forbids systematic complete-area/POI collection.
Its maximum rate is one request per second, with identifying User-Agent/Referer and caching requirements.
Use extracts for complete regional data; this project makes no Nominatim requests.

sources.wikidata_identifier_caveat: The linked object is a place=city,type=multipolygon place polygon without boundary/admin_level; do not treat it as the administrative boundary.
notes: Use the PBF relation tags and assembled geometry to validate city identity and spatial membership.
The extraction bbox 50.8,70.8,51.4,71.9 is a coarse coverage envelope, not an administrative boundary.
No boundary centroid is used as a building coordinate.

findings: A house number can identify a door, building, complex, or land parcel; the tag alone does not prove a building footprint.
Require the complete street and house number together. Preserve slash, suffix, corpus, and building-number distinctions.
Do not infer street identity from nearest-road distance; corner addresses can belong to a different street.

Multilingual aliases may be taken from explicit name/name:ru/name:kk/name:en tags on the same road feature. Reject ambiguous alias collisions; do not automatically transliterate or fuzzily merge names.
Old street names require explicit provenance and a conservative policy; a spelling resemblance is insufficient.
Overpass out center is the object bounding-box center and need not lie inside the polygon.
Use complete referenced node locations to assemble way/relation geometries; never join unrelated rings into a single outline.
Pyosmium with_areas scans relation topology before geometry assembly and preserves separate outer and inner rings.
Reject invalid/incomplete footprints. Preserve holes and multiple outer parts; a multi-building relation is not automatically one house.
For an accepted single building footprint, an interior representative point can be derived locally and labelled as such.

notes: Run at most one bounded request, cache exact response and query, and retain osm3s timestamp plus SHA256.
Building/address and multilingual road data can be retrieved together; this query intentionally preserves tags rather than matching addresses on the server.
The bbox is broader than Astana. Separately validate city-boundary membership before accepting coordinates.
This is a future option only: the current run uses the pinned PBF and performs no further Overpass calls.

acceptance_recommendations: Match exact normalized street plus complete house number to one unique physical building; require consistent city/boundary evidence.
Discard conflicts across candidate footprints, distinct corpora, streets, or ambiguous aliases rather than choosing the nearest candidate.
Deduplicate relation/member-way representations only when their complete physical geometry including holes agrees; retain all source object IDs.

Reject apartment-complex centroids, generic POIs, interpolation, bare address nodes, and multiouter/campus relations for automatic building confirmation unless additional building-level evidence is explicitly implemented.
Keep the raw snapshot, its SHA, extraction version, OSM object IDs/version/edit timestamps, exact source tags, matching rule, and geometry method in provenance.

Keep OSM coordinates separate from historical listing coordinates and any model's learned training-only coordinate map. If model inputs change, historic model metrics do not automatically validate the changed inference path.

notes: This validates topology and provenance, not the address matcher or physical survey accuracy.
Invalid footprint geometries, if present, must be rejected by the matcher; no geometry repair is applied here.
